race.description: Join Racing Owners Club Tasmania Mdn
race.comment: ROLAND VIEW (6) gets the nod in a moderate maiden. Crossed from a wide gate to sit on the speed then battled on well for second last start over this course and distance. Again jumps from a wide alley but with even luck in running she looks a great chance to go one better. BEWICKED (9) returns from a six-month lay-off. Placed at both runs in the maiden campaign, the best effort coming second-up when runner-up over this course and distance. Likely improver over the break and this is a pretty soft first-up assignment. AWESOME ORPHAN (4) is yet to salute in 16 starts but turned in a better run last time out when in the money over 1150m at the Devonport Synthetic. Not drawn the best but another top three finish is on the cards. ALPINE WHISKEY (1) is a lightly raced five-year-old back from a six-month spell. Won two trials in September so he looks ready for a positive return. Betting watch on CALIFORNIA CROWN (10) on debut. Trials have been encouraging.
